premises.text: Public data is valuable because it reflects the real world and reveals insights not found on social media.
premises.evidence_span: this kind of public data is valuable because it's a reflection of the real world, and it reveals things that you won't find by looking at Twitter hashtags or Foursquare check-ins

premises.text: Public data is not easily accessible due to various formats and silos.
premises.evidence_span: public data comes in all kinds of different shapes and forms. Everything from restrictive web portals to messy FTP sites to 1970s database formats and everything else in between

premises.text: A scalable infrastructure is needed to acquire, index, and search public data.
premises.evidence_span: what public data needs is an infrastructure, and that's what we're building at Enigma

premises.text: Enigma can index over 100,000 datasets and billions of records.
premises.evidence_span: we're indexing over 100,000 datasets, billions of records

premises.text: Enigma allows users to discover new datasets and insights.
premises.evidence_span: Enigma is also about discovering new datasets you didn't even know existed or were relevant

premises.text: Enigma's web app and API can facilitate easier data analysis and acquisition.
premises.evidence_span: we're launching our web app and API with partners who really share this vision

value.text: Users can access and analyze public data more effectively.
value.evidence_span: exposing this world that's just been hidden for way too long
